name: NYC Business Acceleration Businesses Served and Jobs Created
description:
This dataset lists New York City businesses served by a business acceleration program, with one row per establishment. Each record includes the business name (DBA), street address, ZIP code, and borough, along with a business sector and more specific establishment category. Where available, it also notes the type of cuisine and the number of employees. An actual opening date is provided for most businesses, recorded as a timestamp.

Coverage is concentrated in Manhattan, Queens, and Brooklyn, and the most common categories are restaurants and other eating places. Several fields are incomplete: business sector is missing for about a quarter of rows, establishment category for about 27%, cuisine for about 40%, and employee counts for about 23%. Borough and ZIP are nearly complete.

The data can be used to map where served businesses are located, compare sectors and business types across boroughs, and study opening dates over time. Employee counts support rough estimates of jobs associated with served establishments, though the missing values mean totals should be treated as
